lead_editorial.title: Virodh ka haq aur rozi-roti ka haq — dono ko bachaane ki pehli zimmedari sarkaar ki hai, adaalat ki nahi
lead_editorial.summary: Supreme Court ne sahi kaha ki protest site par hamesha kabza nahi ho sakta, par usne yeh bhi doharaaya ki har kisi ko virodh ka haq hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai ki Delhi mein pradarshankaariyon ke saath kaisa bartaav hua.
body: Mukhya Chunav Ayukt Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf October mein Delhi mein hue pradarshanon se judi yachikaaon par Tuesday ko Supreme Court mein lambi sunvaai hui. CJI Surya Kant ki bench ne ek taraf kaha ki koi group kisi protest site par hamesha ke liye kabza nahi kar sakta, kyunki dihaadi mazdooron aur doosre logon ki rozi bhi daanv par hoti hai. Doosri taraf bench ne saaf kaha ki 'har kisi ko virodh ka haq hai.'

Yeh santulan sunne mein aasaan lagta hai, par zameen par mushkil hai. Yachikakartaaon ke vakeelon ne lagbhag 7,000 hiraasaton, metro stationon ki bandi, internet par rok aur mahila patrakaaron ke utpeedan jaise gambhir aarop lagaaye hain; Solicitor General ne hiraasat ke aankde ko khaarij karte hue kaha ki logon ko sirf site se hataaya gaya tha. Yeh sab abhi aarop aur pratyaarop hain, jinki jaanch adaalat kar rahi hai. Lekin itne bade paimaane par aarop apne aap mein chinta ka vishay hain.

Hamari raay mein protest ke liye samay-seema tay karna galat nahi hai, basharte yeh niyam sab par ek jaise laagu hon aur pehle se saaf likhe hon. Samasya tab hoti hai jab niyam baad mein, police karyavaahi ke baad, gadhe jaate hain. Sarkaar aur Delhi Police ko chahiye ki woh protest sthalon, samay aur shartein paardarshi tareeke se tay karein, CCTV footage jaise saboot surakshit rakhein — jaisa adaalat pehle hi keh chuki hai — aur shikaayaton ki nishpaksh jaanch karaayein.

Lokatantra mein Chunav Ayog jaisi sanstha par sawaal uthana bhi lokatantrik adhikaar hai, aur un sawaalon ka jawaab dena sansthaon ki zimmedari. Sadak par asantosh ka hal laathi ya internet bandi nahi, balki samvaad aur bharosa hai. Supreme Court ne nau shreniyon mein sunvaai ka jo raasta chuna hai, umeed hai usse jald aur spasht jawaab niklega.

stories.title: Supreme Court: 'Protest site par hamesha ke liye kabza nahi ho sakta, par virodh sabka haq'; CEC-virodhi pradarshanon par police karyavaahi ki yachikaayein 9 shreniyon mein sunegi adaalat
stories.summary: CJI Surya Kant ki bench ne Delhi mein Mukhya Chunav Ayukt Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf hue pradarshanon, hiraasaton aur internet bandi se judi yachikaaon ko nau shreniyon mein baant kar alag-alag sunne ka faisla kiya.
body: Supreme Court ne Tuesday ko October 2026 mein Delhi mein Mukhya Chunav Ayukt (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf hue pradarshanon se judi kai yachikaaon par sunvaai ki. Bar and Bench ke mutabik yeh pradarshan voter list ke punarikshan (electoral roll revision) ko lekar the. CJI Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi aur Justice V Mohana ki bench ne vyapaariyon ki ek yachika par kaha ki koi bhi group kisi protest site par hamesha ke liye kabza nahi kar sakta, taaki doosre logon ko bhi virodh ka mauka mile. CJI ne dihaadi mazdooron ki rozi ka sawaal bhi uthaaya. Vyapaariyon ki taraf se senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi ne Rs 2,000 crore ke nuksaan ka daava kiya; Justice Bagchi ne poochha ki kya bikri mein kami ke liye sirf pradarshan zimmedaar hain, jabki sarkaari barricading aur dukaanon ki bandi ka bhi asar hota hai. Adaalat ne vyapaariyon se pradarshan ke aayojakon ko bhi paksh banaane ko kaha.

The Pioneer ki report ke mutabik pradarshankaariyon ki taraf se senior advocate Menaka Guruswamy ne lagbhag 7,000 hiraasaton ka aarop lagaaya, jabki Solicitor General Tushar Mehta ne isse inkaar karte hue kaha ki logon ko hiraasat mein nahi, sirf site se hataaya gaya tha. Yachikaaon mein police ki zyaadti, metro stationon ki bandi, internet par rok aur pradarshankaariyon ki photo-video jutaane ke aarop bhi hain. Bench ne muddon ko nau shreniyon mein baanta hai aur unhe alag-alag sunegi. Mahila patrakaaron ke kathit utpeedan wali yachika par 23 November ko alag sunvaai hogi. Adaalat pehle hi CCTV footage aur digital saboot surakshit rakhne ka nirdesh de chuki hai.

stories.title: Navy ko milenge 8 swadeshi 'Next Generation Corvettes': Raksha Mantralaya ne GRSE aur Goa Shipyard ke saath Rs 53,866 crore ke contract kiye
stories.summary: Kolkata ka GRSE paanch aur Goa Shipyard teen corvette banaayega. Mantralaya ke mutabik is project se das saal mein kareeb 532 lakh person-days ka rozgaar paida hoga.
body: Raksha Mantralaya ne Somvaar, 2 November ko New Delhi ke Kartavya Bhawan-2 mein Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh ki maujoodgi mein aath Next Generation Corvettes (NGC) ke liye kul Rs 53,866.50 crore ke contract par dastakhat kiye. Business Today ke mutabik Kolkata ki Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) paanch aur Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) teen jahaz banaayegi. In jahazon ka design Indian Navy ne khud taiyaar kiya hai, aur mantralaya ne ise swadeshi yudhpot design aur nirmaan mein ek 'significant milestone' bataaya hai.

Yeh corvettes aadhunik missile, hathiyaaron aur sensor suite se las hongi aur hawa, samundar ki satah aur paani ke neeche — teeno kshetron mein kaam kar sakengi. Inki bhoomika mein samudri vyapar raaston ki suraksha, anti-submarine warfare, tateey raksha aur nigraani shaamil hai. Indian Masterminds ki report ke mutabik Cabinet Committee on Security ne pichhle hafte is project ko manzoori di thi aur pehla jahaz contract ke baad 2030 tak milne ki ummeed hai. Mantralaya ka anumaan hai ki das saal mein lagbhag 532 lakh person-days rozgaar banega, jismein se zyaadatar MSME aur sahaayak udyogon mein hoga.

image.credit: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
image.alt: GRSE mein ek Arnala-class ASW corvette ka launch (file photo; nayi Next Generation Corvette nahi)

editorial.title: Corvette sauda swaagat yogya hai, par aatmanirbharta ka asli imtihaan samay par delivery mein hoga
body: Aath corvette ka Rs 53,866 crore ka sauda kai maayne mein khaas hai — design Navy ka apna hai aur nirmaan desh ke do sarkaari shipyard karenge. Aise samay mein jab Khaadi aur Arab Sagar mein vyaapaarik jahazon par khatra badh raha hai, tateey suraksha aur samudri raaston ki nigraani ke liye aise jahazon ki zaroorat saaf dikhti hai.

Lekin Bharat ke rakshaa nirmaan ka itihaas batata hai ki contract sign hona aadhi kahaani hai. Kai pichhle projects mein deri aur laagat badhne ki shikaayatein rahi hain. Hamari raay mein Navy, mantralaya aur shipyards ko pehle din se paardarshi milestone tay karne chahiye aur sansad ko unki pragati ki niyamit jaankari deni chahiye. Rozgaar aur MSME ko fayda tabhi milega jab jahaz samay par paani mein utrein.

stories.title: America midterms mein ginti jaari: Georgia mein Ossoff aur Virginia mein Warner ki jeet ka anumaan; CBS exit poll mein Trump ki approval sirf 38%
stories.summary: Polls band hone ke saath shuruaati nateeje aane lage hain. Democrats ne do Senate seatein bachaane ke sanket diye hain, lekin House aur Senate par kiska kabza hoga, yeh tay hone mein ghante ya din lag sakte hain.
body: America mein Tuesday ko hue midterm chunav mein voting khatm hote hi nateeje aane shuru ho gaye hain. NewsNation aur Decision Desk HQ ne Georgia ki Senate seat par Democrat Jon Ossoff ki jeet ka anumaan lagaaya hai; unhone Trump-samarthit Republican sansad Mike Collins ko haraaya. ABC News ke mutabik Virginia mein Democrat Senator Mark Warner ko Republican Bert Mizusawa par jeet ka anumaan hai. Abhi tak House ya Senate par niyantran ko lekar koi projection nahi aaya hai. Chunav se pehle Republicans ke paas Senate mein 53-47 aur House mein maamooli bahumat tha.

CBS News ke shuruaati exit poll ke mutabik voters mein President Trump ki approval 38% hai, jise CBS ne in pollon mein kisi midterm ke dauraan kisi bhi raashtrapati ki sabse kam approval bataaya hai. Lagbhag teen-chauthai voters desh ki disha se kam se kam asantusht hain aur arthvyavastha ko lekar nakaaraatmak raay 2024 se zyada hai. Al Jazeera ke mutabik California, Arizona, Nevada, Alaska aur Maine jaise rajyon mein ginti dheemi hoti hai, isliye kareebi muqablon ka faisla dinon tak tal sakta hai — 2024 mein House ka niyantran tay hone mein aath din lage the.

stories.title: Ukraine ke Zaporizhzhia mein madad baantne waale school par Russi bambaari, kam se kam 33 ki maut; Zelensky bole — 'behad bhayaavah hamla'
stories.summary: Komyshuvakha mein jis school mein har hafte rahat saamagri baanti jaati thi, wahan aur paas ke shelter par kai guided bomb gire. Dazanon log ab bhi laapata hain.
body: Kyiv Independent ki report ke mutabik Somvaar, 2 November ko Russi senaaon ne Zaporizhzhia Oblast ke Komyshuvakha mein kai baar hawaai bomb giraaye. Pehla hamla ek school par hua jahan niyamit roop se humanitarian aid baanti jaati thi; Zelensky ke mutabik iske baad ek shelter par nau aur bomb giraaye gaye jahan log chhupe the. Report ke mutabik kam se kam 33 logon ki maut hui, jinmein do rescue worker aur chaar police adhikaari shaamil hain. Governor Mykhailo Semikin ne 48 logon ke laapata hone ki baat kahi hai.

Zelensky ne ise 'exceptionally horrific strike' bataaya aur kaha ki yeh dikhaata hai ki Russia tanaav kam nahi karna chahta. Komyshuvakha front line se kareeb 20 km door hai. Yeh hamla aise waqt hua hai jab America ke vishesh doot Steve Witkoff ne 10-11 November ko Abu Dhabi mein America, Russia aur Ukraine ke beech baatcheet ka elaan kiya hai. Just Security ke news roundup ke mutabik Zelensky ne yeh chetavani bhi di hai ki Russia America ke midterms ke dauraan urja dhaanche par bada hamla kar sakta hai.

image.alt: Zaporizhzhia Oblast ke Komyshuvakha ka ek purana drishya (file photo, hamle ki tasveer nahi)

editorial.title: Midterms ka shuruaati sandesh: naaraz voter kisi bhi taaqatvar sarkaar ko jawaabdeh bana sakta hai
body: Abhi poore nateeje aane baaki hain aur jaldbaazi mein nishkarsh nikaalna theek nahi hoga. Phir bhi exit poll mein raashtrapati ki 38% approval aur arthvyavastha ko lekar vyaapak asantosh yeh dikhata hai ki America ka voter mehngaai aur anishchitata ko lekar bechain hai.

Bharat ke liye nateejon ka matlab vyapaar, H-1B jaise muddon aur West Asia neeti par pad sakta hai — khaaskar agar Congress aur White House mein alag-alag dal ka dabdaba ho. Hamari raay mein Nayi Dilli ko kisi ek dal par daanv lagaane ke bajaay donon taraf ke saath rishte mazboot rakhne ki apni purani neeti par tike rehna chahiye. Saath hi Ukraine mein aid kendra par hua hamla yaad dilaata hai ki chunavi shor ke beech bhi shaanti vaarta ki zaroorat kitni tatkaal hai.

stories.title: Listing ke baad NSE ke pehle nateeje: September timahi mein munafa 23% badhkar Rs 2,578 crore, cash market ka rozaana turnover 24% upar
stories.summary: Total income 9% badhkar Rs 4,554 crore rahi. Kharch aadhe se zyada ghata, kyunki pichhle saal SEBI settlement ke liye Rs 1,297 crore ka provision kiya gaya tha.
body: National Stock Exchange (NSE) ne listing ke baad apne pehle timaahi nateeje jaari kiye hain. Business Today ke mutabik July-September timahi mein NSE ka consolidated munafa saal-dar-saal 23% badhkar Rs 2,578 crore aur total income 9% badhkar Rs 4,554 crore rahi. Sabse bade revenue strot transaction charges se Rs 3,035 crore aaye. Listing services se kamaai 70% aur data feed services se 43% badhi. EPS Rs 8.48 se badhkar Rs 10.41 ho gaya.

Kharch 51% ghatkar Rs 1,161 crore raha, jiski mukhya wajah yeh hai ki pichhle saal isi timahi mein colocation aur dark fibre maamlon se jude SEBI settlement ke liye Rs 1,297 crore ka provision kiya gaya tha. Cash market ka ausat dainik turnover 24% badhkar Rs 1,18,377 crore raha, jabki premium ke hisaab se equity options volume sirf 3% badha. CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan ne listing ko NSE ke safar ka ek ahem padaav bataaya. Report ke mutabik pehli chhamahi mein NSE ne securities aur commodities transaction tax samet Rs 41,234 crore sarkaari khazaane mein diye.

image.alt: Mumbai mein National Stock Exchange ki imaarat (file photo)

stories.title: Wall Street mila-jula: Nasdaq 0.8% chadha, Dow 197 ank phisla; Brent $103.60 par, aaj Nifty ke liye 24,000 ka star ahem
stories.summary: America mein midterm voting ke din chip shares mein vaapsi hui, jabki Apple ki kamzori ne Dow ko neeche kheencha. Nifty Tuesday ko lagaataar chauthe din chadhkar din ke uchchtam star par band hua tha.
body: StockTitan ke market roundup ke mutabik Tuesday ko Nasdaq 0.83% aur S&P 500 0.36% chadhe, jabki Dow Jones 197 ank (lagbhag 0.38%) gira. Apple ke share mein kamzor margin forecast ke baad 1.9% ki giravat ne Dow par dabaav daala. Iran ke saath samjhaute ki ummeed mein Brent crude 1.12% girkar $103.60 prati barrel par settle hua; Somvaar ko yeh 7% se zyada gira tha. America ka 10-saal ka Treasury yield kareeb 4.91% raha.

Ghar mein, 5paisa ke vishleshan ke mutabik Nifty Tuesday ko 370 ank (1.58%) chadhkar 23,810.85 par band hua, jo din ka uchchtam star tha; 50 mein se 38 share hare nishaan mein rahe. Analysts ke mutabik 24,000-24,216 ka daayra agla rukaavat star hai, jabki short-term charts overbought hone ke kaaran munafa-vasooli ki sambhaavna bhi jataayi gayi hai. America ke chunav nateejon aur crude ki chaal par aaj baazaar ki nazar rahegi. (Yeh nivesh salah nahi hai.)

editorial.title: NSE ka munafa sirf ek company ki kahaani nahi, Bharat ke retail nivesh ke josh ka aaina hai
body: NSE ke nateeje bataate hain ki cash market mein trading tezi se badhi hai, jabki options mein badhat dheemi padi hai. Yeh sanket ho sakta hai ki SEBI ke derivatives par sakht niyamon ke baad nivesh ka rukh dheere-dheere cash market ki taraf mud raha hai — jo lambe samay mein sehatmand hai.

Lekin ek listed exchange ke liye zyada volume ka matlab zyada munafa hai, aur yahi hiton ke takraav ka sawaal bhi uthata hai. Hamari raay mein ab NSE ki jawaabdehi aur badh gayi hai: use apne shareholders ke saath-saath baazaar ki imaandaari aur chhote niveshakon ki suraksha ko bhi barabar praathmikta deni hogi. Colocation jaise purane maamle yaad dilaate hain ki technology aur paardarshita mein kami ki keemat aakhirkaar niveshak chukaate hain.

stories.title: 'Ramayana: Part 1' ki aaj raat 9 baje se paid previews; pehle din ki advance booking Rs 39 crore ke paar, 10 lakh se zyada ticket bike
stories.summary: Sacnilk ke subah 6 baje tak ke aankdon ke mutabik Thursday ki release ke liye Bharat mein 23,671 shows mein 10.11 lakh ticket bik chuke hain.
body: 'Ramayana: Part 1', jismein Ranbir Kapoor Ram, Sai Pallavi Sita aur Yash Ravan ki bhoomika mein hain, Thursday, 5 November ko desh bhar mein release ho rahi hai. India TV ki report ke mutabik film ki paid previews Budhvaar, 4 November ko raat 9 baje se shuru hongi. Box office tracking site Sacnilk ke mutabik release ke pehle din ke liye Bharat mein advance booking se Rs 39.35 crore (block seats chhodkar Rs 33.34 crore) ka gross ho chuka hai aur 10.11 lakh ticket bike hain.

Sacnilk ke aankdon mein pehle din ke liye 23,671 shows aur kareeb 19% occupancy darj hai. Pichhle hafte Bombay High Court ne release se pehle film ko online piracy se bachaane ke liye dynamic injunction diya tha. Trade ki nazar ab is par hai ki film opening day par kitna kamaati hai aur previews ki pratikriya weekend ki booking par kya asar daalti hai.

image.alt: Abhineta Ranbir Kapoor (April 2024 ki file photo)

stories.title: Eden Park mein India-New Zealand paanch ODI series ka pehla muqabla aaj subah 7:30 se; Gill ki kaptaani mein Rohit-Kohli ki vaapsi
stories.summary: Shubman Gill aur Mitchell Santner ki teamein Auckland mein aamne-saamne hain. Rohit Sharma aur Virat Kohli lagbhag ek mahine baad national duty par laute hain.
body: India aur New Zealand ke beech paanch ODI matchon ki series ka pehla match Budhvaar ko Auckland ke Eden Park mein Bharatiya samay ke mutabik subah 7:30 baje se khela ja raha hai. ETV Bharat ke mutabik India ki kaptaani Shubman Gill aur New Zealand ki Mitchell Santner kar rahe hain, aur Rohit Sharma tatha Virat Kohli lagbhag ek mahine baad team mein laute hain.

Yahoo Sports par chhapi match preview mein New Zealand ke Daryl Mitchell ko mezbaan team ka sabse ahem ballebaaz bataaya gaya hai, jabki India ki ranneeti Gill, Rohit aur Kohli ke ird-gird ghoomti hai. Match ka nateeja hum Shaam Edition mein laayenge.

image.credit: Kiwi Flickr from Auckland, New Zealand
image.alt: Auckland ke Eden Park stadium ka panorama (file photo)

stories.title: AMD ki record timahi: revenue 45% badhkar $13.4 billion, data centre bikri lagbhag dogni; share after-hours mein 6% se zyada chadha
stories.summary: AI chips ki maang ke dam par AMD ne apne hi anumaan ko peeche chhoda aur October-December timahi ke liye kareeb $17 billion revenue ka anumaan diya.
body: Chip company AMD ne Tuesday ko baazaar band hone ke baad July-September timahi ke nateeje jaari kiye. StockTitan ke mutabik company ka revenue record $13.4 billion raha, jo pichhle saal se lagbhag 45% zyada aur company ke apne anumaan ki upari seema se bhi upar hai. Data centre segment ki bikri 97% badhkar $8.5 billion pahunchi.

AMD ne chauthi timahi ke liye lagbhag $17 billion revenue ka anumaan diya hai. Nateejon ke baad after-hours trading mein share ek samay 8% se zyada chadha aur shaam 7 baje (ET) tak lagbhag 6.6% upar tha. Yeh nateeje aise samay aaye hain jab AI infrastructure par bhaari kharch se munafe ko lekar niveshakon mein sawaal uth rahe hain.

image.alt: Santa Clara, California mein 2485 Augustine Drive par AMD ka headquarters (file photo)

editorial.title: Ramayana ki record booking Bharatiya cinema ke bade daanv ki pehli jeet hai, par asli faisla darshak karenge
body: Release se pehle hi das lakh se zyada ticket bikna batata hai ki bade paimaane ki Bharatiya film ke liye darshakon mein kitni utsukta hai. Ek aisi kahaani jo har ghar mein jaani-pehchaani hai, use naye tareeke se pesh karna jokhim bhara bhi hai aur avsar bhi.

Hamari raay mein advance booking ka shor sirf shuruaat hai. Film ki lambi umr uski kahaani, abhinay aur bhavnaatmak sachchaai par tikegi, VFX ke chamak-damak par nahi. Agar 'Ramayana' safal hoti hai, to yeh dikhayegi ki Bharatiya studio bhi vishwa-star par mahatvakaankshi projects bana sakte hain — aur saath hi piracy ke khilaaf kaanooni kavach ki ahmiyat bhi.
